data.description:
BUILDPLAN.md T-16 (M3).

The generator: Claude Opus 5 via Message Batches, structured outputs into the §3.1 shape, count/topics/difficulty honoured or reported, talk mode, per-candidate cost and wall-clock, re-runnable

Criteria: AC-1–5
Harness hooks: see EVALUATION.md rows for those IDs; `just test` is the inner loop (≤ 60 s).
Depends on (BUILDPLAN): T-14
BUILDPLAN notes: Human track: API key, spend cap. Serialized on `pyproject.toml`. The generator's brief carries the room's capacity — source lines at the floor, each option a single line, at most 29 characters (`SPEC.md` §7.1, D-15). The brief also carries the style rules and the §11.1 patterns (D-23).

Orchestrator notes: Human track H-4. Buildable and testable on fixtures without the key; the first paid run is HC-2.

HELD: needs H-4 an Anthropic API key and spend cap. Do not dispatch until the client releases it.

Workflow mode: inline-full. Terminal pre-merge status: review. PR base: origin/main.
Standing clauses: criteria outrank SPEC on behaviour, state, payloads and copy; SPEC outranks the prototype, which wins on visual detail only. Never write down what a program prints. Answer position is a uniform draw from the date, never balanced. Miri proves absence of UB on executed paths only. Colour is never the only signal. Code never causes horizontal page scroll. Never `git add -A`. Signing goes through 1Password: retry once, then escalate.

Plan: filled in by the delegator's plan phase.

data.body: DISPATCH 2026-10-10 [client: "dispatch it fixtures-only"]. H-4 (API key + spend cap) remains open; this dispatch builds and proves the generator on recorded fixtures only — no call to the Anthropic API, no key read. `held` replaced by `fixtures-only`. Mode inline-full, actor agent:delegator-pq21, worktree …-worktrees/generator-batches, branch ai-c11-cc/generator-batches off origin/main @ a3c8c4e. Rulings: (1) fixtures only, tests pass with no key and no network, a guard test proves it; (2) one seam (submit/poll/results) like the verifier Runner (D-18): real SDK client written but unexercised until HC-2, replay client over fixtures in the SDK result shape (clean, errored, expired, over-capacity, invalid shape); (3) model ID one config value, default claude-opus-5 per D-D, the Opus 5.5 question goes to the client in DONE; (4) spend cap configured with no default, refuse before submitting when unset or worst-case estimate exceeds it; (5) brief carries the three capacity facts from the room config and §11.1 from popquiz.copylint, asserted with a mutation; (6) report, never trim (D-15), and name which of count/topics/difficulty was not honoured; (7) §3.1 minus verified/review, no model-claimed output in any answer field, no answer position, bank.py imported not changed; (8) talk mode tags a std/core concept on fixtures; (9) atomic writes, kill-and-rerun under test-full, never into bank/questions or PR #59 files; (10) per-candidate tokens/cost/wall-clock labelled as fixture numbers; (11) AC-1 static check is PQ-47s, .env.example gets one ANTHROPIC_API_KEY= line only, ECONOMICS untouched. Cleared: pipeline/src/popquiz/generate*.py, pipeline/tests/test_generate*.py, pipeline/tests/fixtures/generate/**, pipeline/pyproject.toml + uv.lock (anthropic only), pipeline/README.md (generate lines), justfile (one recipe), .env.example (one line). Boot prompt: templates/boot-PQ-21.md.
